note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the two scenes differ only in whether one source has been supplied, and no conclusion about the propositions is drawn.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Three propositions, two sources; only whether the delivery log (S2) has been supplied differs. In A the row-2 pin lands in the S2 cell; in B it stays on its card and an empty socket marks the cell.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four propositions and three sources; the changed fact is whether the inspection report (R1) has been supplied, which two rows cite — in B both of those pins stay on their cards, while the photo-log and invoice citations land identically in both scenes.
